title: Heuristic alert attenuator and multiregion circuit-breaker playbook
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and ship a two-tiered system that reduces noisy pages while preserving high-fidelity SLO alerts: (1) a heuristic alert attenuator (HAA) that demotes low-confidence signals into an async attention queue and emits actionable alerts only when correlated with system or customer-visible signals, and (2) a multiregion circuit-breaker playbook that gracefully sheds load and triggers prefailover diagnostics when regional error budgets approach thresholds. This ticket covers design decisions, a short implementation plan, an on-call runbook excerpt, and automation hooks for post-detection remediation and dry-run failovers.
acceptance_criteria: HAA prototype running in staging that reduces page rate from non-actionable rules by >=60% on the sample traffic window (7-day baseline)

Circuit-breaker policy implemented per-region that: trips at configured error-rate or latency SLO breach, enforces hysteresis for minimum 3 minutes, and supports a configurable emergency bypass for manual operator action
On-call runbook updated with step-by-step diagnostics (prefailover checks, KV cache validation, routing sanity), and automated playbooks wired to the on-call pager escalation
Automated dry-run failover and preflight checks documented and tested in a canary region; PRs and dashboards linked
Alerting dashboard shows distinct channels: attenuated_signals, action_alerts, and prefailover_alerts with run rate metrics for at least 48 hours without increased customer-visible errors
steps: Week 1: Implement HAA scoring rules and an async queue consumer in staging; add feature flag for attenuation
Week 2: Add correlation rules to combine HAA scores with customer-visible error rates, SLO burn markers, and infra anomalies
Week 3: Implement per-region circuit-breaker with hysteresis and stateful metrics export; integrate with smart routing to mark region as degraded (not fully failed)
Week 4: Build automated prefailover diagnostics (kv_cache_check, model_variant_fallback_test, latency_heatmap snapshot) and wire to playbook
Week 5: Run dry-run failovers from staging to canary region, document learnings, and iterate thresholds
Ongoing: Tune attenuation thresholds based on weekly on-call feedback and alert noise metrics
runbook_excerpt: Title: Region Degradation — HAA + Circuit Breaker triggered
1) Immediate check: Confirm HAA score > 0.7 AND region error-rate > 5% above baseline (Grafana dashboard: SLO > error-budget burn). If both false, mark as attenuated and comment on ticket.
2) If true: run prefailover diagnostics: run ./scripts/kv_cache_check --region=<region>; expect <90% key-read hit and no >5% RPC errors

3) Run model-variant smoke sample: send 20 sample requests to primary variant and fallback variant; compare latencies and error rates. If fallback looks healthy, escalate to apply temporary routing rule to shift 10% traffic.

4) If diagnostics fail: engage regional circuit-breaker: set breaker to TRIPPED state (console toggle) — this triggers automatic throttling policy and begins controlled shedding according to configured tiers
5) Notify SRE lead and PM via #reliability with runbook link and dry-run ID; open incident in Incident Manager with tag 'prefailover'.
6) If circuit-breaker does not reduce customer errors within 5 minutes, initiate multiregion reroute per policy (see automated_playbooks) and begin canary failover sequence
7) Post-incident: save diagnostic artifacts, attach to ticket and run alarm noise delta report; schedule tuning session if noise reduction < goal
automated_playbooks: attenuate_low_fidelity_alerts: takes low-confidence alerts, enriches with SLO burn markers and infra anomalies, demotes to info or queues as a digest
prefailover_diagnostics: orchestrates kv cache checks, routing sanity, model smoke tests, and collects traces into a single artifact
dryrun_multiregion_reroute: performs a controlled 0.1% traffic shift to target region, validates end-to-end trace and SLI surface for 5 minutes, and aborts on regression
circuit_breaker_engage: flips circuit state via API, emits audit event, and invokes shedding policy with step-down percentages
